column1: "review": "Since the last update spell check is completely broken. Doesn't flag any errors at all."
"review": "Export to PDF crashes halfway through on large documents. Never used to have this problem."
"review": "App drains 40% of battery in 30 minutes when it's just sitting in the background. Clear bug."
"review": "Not sure if this is a bug or by design but my headers don't print correctly on some printers."
"review": "Would be nice to have a translation feature built in. Google Docs has this and it's really useful."
"review": "It would be great if Word had a focus mode hiding the toolbar so you can just write
"review": "I would love a feature showing estimated reading time for a document. Very useful for presentations."
"review": "Please add real-time collaboration with voice chat built in. Makes remote work so much easier."
"review": "Comments panel disappeared after the update and I can't get it back no matter what I try."
"review": "Undo button stopped working after today's update. Lost a whole section I can't recover."
"review": "Formatting gets messed up switching between phone and tablet. Headings resize and margins shift."
"review": "The layout changed in the update and I can't find page layout settings anymore. Very confusing."
"review": "This app feels much slower than it used to. Not sure if my phone or the app. Maybe needs optimization?"
"review": "Images keep moving around randomly. Layout doesn't stay fixed no matter what I try."
